headline: Room Attendant
summary: TESDA-certified housekeeper looking for my first hotel room attendant job. During on-the-job training at a Bulacan hotel I cleaned and set up guest rooms to inspection standard, handled guest laundry and linen, and helped guests politely with their requests. I work quickly and pay attention to detail.
skills: Safe use of cleaning chemicals and equipment

experience.title: Housekeeping Trainee (OJT)
bullets: Prepared 10 to 12 rooms a shift under a room attendant's supervision.
Sorted, washed and folded guest laundry and linen in the laundry room.
Delivered amenities and answered guest requests politely.

education.credential: Senior High School, TVL Track – Home Economics strand
